function.name: list_agents
function.description: Get the list of available booking agents (master tailors). Call this when a customer wants to book an appointment so you can ask for their preference.

function.name: get_available_slots
function.description: Find open appointment slots for a given date range, optionally filtered by agent. Call this after getting the customer's preferred dates and agent.

date_from.description: Start of date range, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

date_to.description: End of date range, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

agent_name.description: Optional: filter to a specific agent's availability

service_type.description: Type of appointment: Initial Consultation, Fitting, Alteration, Alteration Pickup

function.name: check_alteration_eligibility
function.description: Check if a customer is eligible for alteration services. Must be called before booking any Alteration appointment. Eligibility requires a completed order with L&S in the past 12 months.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book a confirmed appointment slot. Only call this after showing the customer available slots and getting their explicit confirmation.

slot_datetime.description: The confirmed slot datetime (ISO format or human-readable)

preferred_agent.description: Agent name the customer chose (or empty for any available)

service_type.description: Type of service: Consultation, Fitting, Alteration, Bespoke, Made-to-Measure

function.name: check_order_status
function.description: Look up the status of a customer's tailoring order. Use when they ask about their garment, fitting, or delivery.

customer_phone.description: Customer phone if order number unknown

function.name: check_appointment
function.description: Look up a customer's existing appointment. Use when they ask about a scheduled visit or fitting.

function.name: get_store_info
function.description: Retrieve store information: hours, location, services, trunk shows, policies.

topic.description: Topic: hours, location, services, trunk_shows, policies, about

function.name: check_fabric_availability
function.description: Answer fabric or material questions and guide the customer toward a consultation.

fabric_name.description: Fabric or mill name (e.g. Loro Piana, Dormeuil)

function.name: check_square_payment
function.description: Verify payment status for an order via Square.

order_number.description: Order number to check payment for

function.name: forward_call
function.description: Transfer the current voice call to a human staff member. Use ONLY when: (1) customer explicitly asks to speak with a person, (2) situation requires immediate human judgment, (3) customer is distressed.

function.name: staff_daily_schedule
function.description: Staff only. List the appointments for a given day. Use when a staff member asks who is coming in today or on a specific date.

date.description: Day to look up, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for today.

function.name: staff_overdue_orders
function.description: Staff only. List Sales Orders that are past their delivery date and not yet completed. Use when a staff member asks what is overdue or late.

function.name: staff_ready_for_pickup
function.description: Staff only. List garments currently marked Ready for Pickup. Use when a staff member asks what is ready or waiting for customers.

function.name: send_internal_sms
function.description: Send a message to a specific staff member. Internal mode only.

function.name: create_follow_up
function.description: Create a follow-up task or reminder for the team about a customer.

function.name: update_order_notes
function.description: Update notes or status on a Sales Order. Internal staff only.
